description: A deckle-edged black-and-white snapshot from 1958 showing three adults—identified as Mr. and Mrs. Cutler and Jeanette—sitting atop a wooden picnic table outdoors on a bright sunny day. The older couple and younger woman are dressed in typical 1950s casual summer attire, posing warmly in a park or wooded yard setting.
